questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Eastern Storm or Rhinos?
questions.explanation: Eastern Storm lead 14-7 across 23 meetings (List A).

questions.question: Iinyathi set a database record (05/06 season, List A) with a value of 331. Which record is it?
options: Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Highest Team Total', held by Iinyathi.

questions.question: At which ground did Asakhe Nyovane record their career-best bowling figures (2-3, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Khaya Majola Oval, against Kei on 2019/10/27.

questions.question: How many 50+ scores separate the all-time #1 (Tazmin Brits) and #2 (Laura Wolvaardt) half-century makers (List A) in the 19/20 season?
questions.explanation: Tazmin Brits: 3 — Laura Wolvaardt: 2 — a gap of 1.

questions.question: At which ground did Tuskers record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 30, against Limpopo Lillies on 2022/03/13.

questions.question: Which South African provincial union has a team playing in the Women's Japan Premier League?
questions.explanation: A result of the partnership between Titans Cricket Union and Japan Cricket Association.
